set system host-name BRAS.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set routing-options multicast mroute 200.explanation: The command configures a static multicast route (mroute) in Junos, specifying the multicast group or source-group pair for routing multicast traffic.

next-hop 2001:db8:1::1.explanation: The command `next-hop [parameter2]` specifies the next-hop IP address or interface for routing traffic in a Junos routing policy or static route configuration.

set routing-options multicast mroute FF1.explanation: The command configures a static multicast route (mroute) in Junos, specifying the multicast group or source with `[parameter1]` for routing multicast traffic.

next-hop ge-0/0/0.0.explanation: The command `next-hop [parameter2]` specifies the next-hop IP address or interface for routing traffic in Junos, directing packets to the specified destination.

set routing-options multicast mroute FF1.explanation: The command configures a static multicast route (mroute) in Junos, specifying the multicast group or source-group pair for forwarding multicast traffic.

next-hop ge-0/0/0.0.explanation: The command `next-hop [parameter2]` specifies the next-hop IP address or interface for routing traffic in a Junos routing policy or static route configuration.

set system authentication-order radius.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

set system radius-server 192.168.1.100.explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

secret \"radius-secret\".explanation: Configure IP addresses and shared keys for RADIGUS servers.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: A shared key to communicating with the RADIGUS server.

set system login user admin.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication-order radius.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system login user.

class super-user.explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication-methods ppp.explanation: The `authentication-methods [parameter2]` command in Junos specifies the authentication method (e.g., password, public-key) for user access or protocol authentication.

set system accounting events login.explanation: Configure the accounting events for login sessions.

parameters.name: event-type
parameters.explanation: Types of accounting events, such as login sessions.

set system accounting events ppp.explanation: Configure the accounting events for login sessions.

parameters.name: event-type
parameters.explanation: Types of accounting events, such as login sessions.

set system accounting delay-start.explanation: Configure the delayed start of accounting.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

vlan-id 133.explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

set system services dhcp ipv6-pool pool-.command: set system services dhcp ipv6-pool pool-name
set system services dhcp ipv6-pool pool-.explanation: The command configures an IPv6 DHCP pool named `[parameter1]` on the Junos device, enabling it to assign IPv6 addresses to clients from this pool.

prefix-delegation.explanation: The `prefix-delegation` command in Junos enables the router to request and assign IPv6 prefixes to downstream devices via DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation (PD).
